data.narrative:
Rebellions is a pre-IPO semiconductor company seeking valuation guidance. The analysis relies on a universe of 11 comparable companies in Chips & Semiconductors: 3 public peers (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private firms spanning Series A through later stages, including SambaNova Systems ($11.0B), PsiQuantum ($7.0B), Etched ($5.0B), Tenstorrent ($2.7B), and Ouster ($2.3B).

The peer-median method is applicable and yields a central estimate. Across 9 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier peers, the median valuation is $2.3B, with a range of $529M to $11.0B. This approach anchors the analysis directly to observable transaction and funding multiples in the semiconductor frontier-tech space. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales (median 21.5x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied because Rebellions' revenue is not disclosed, consistent with private company practice.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.9B (low) to $2.6B (high), centered on $2.3B. This aligns closely with Rebellions' current $2.34B valuation and reflects the peer-median estimate. The analysis is constrained by reliance on a single applicable method. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and growth trajectory—without disclosed financials, the range cannot be narrowed by profitability or growth-adjusted multiples. The wide dispersion in peer valuations ($529M–$11.0B) signals sector heterogeneity in capital requirements and time-to-revenue across chip architecture plays.
